case.title: Customer first names the wrong day, then corrects it
case.persona: Rohan Mehta, polite, a bit rushed
case.goal: Move your existing appointment from Tuesday to Thursday at 3 PM (existing appointment is with the same doctor and branch you already go to)
quirks: First say you want to move it to Wednesday at 3 PM. After the agent responds, say 'sorry, I mean Thursday, not Wednesday'
case.precondition: Customer first asked for Wednesday and then corrected to Thursday.
criteria: The agent used Thursday (not Wednesday) for the final new appointment time
The agent confirmed the corrected day and time back to the customer before or when finishing
The agent did not repeatedly ask for information the customer had already given

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hi Maya, I need to reschedule my upcoming appointment please.
What new date and time would you like to move your appointment to?
Can we move it to Wednesday at three in the afternoon?
I've rescheduled your appointment with Dr. Rajendra Prasad at Koramangala to tomorrow at three in the afternoon. Is there anything else I can help with?
Sorry, I mean Thursday, not Wednesday.
I've moved your appointment to Thursday at three in the afternoon. Is there anything else I can help with?
That is all I needed, thank you so much for your help. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
